summary: Argan, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, announcing that its board declared a 40% increase in the quarterly cash dividend, from $0.50 to $0.70 per common share, or $2.80 annualized. The dividend is payable October 30, 2026, to holders of record October 22, 2026. No advisor was named. This marks the fourth consecutive annual increase, supported by power-generation demand from datacenters and electrification. Watch for sustainability of free cash flow and payout coverage versus project timing and backlog conversion.
